examFormat.sourceNote: Per cab.ca.gov/cand/cse/index.shtml. Item count and time limit are in the Handbook (not yet downloaded).

testPlanFacts: The Test Plan is built from a periodic statewide occupational analysis (OA) of California architectural practice.
It focuses on California-specific practice and drops content already covered by the ARE, so it is not a full survey of architectural practice.
Task and knowledge statements keep the numbering assigned during the OA. Not every OA statement appears in the final Test Plan.
